messages.text: BL-1740 🎵 in progress — extension/test/bl1505DedupSuppressedChaseCountInvariants.property.test.js is red whenever the live swarm is paused - chase_sweep_lib.bb's run-sweep! reads the control pause through handoff-lib/pause-hold-active?, which resolves the LIVE project root from git's common dir, so a fixture sweep run from any checkout or worktree holds its fixture parcel while a closing ceremony or bedtime pause is active (3 of 3 red at 07:28Z on 2026-09-25, inside the 07:11-07:45Z ceremony pause; green on main at 08:07Z); the sweep takes the pause reading from its adapters like every other reading, and handoffd passes the live one
